## June 25, 2026 — Codex Remote GA + CLI 0.142.1 / 0.142.2 [reported prior scan]
- Codex Remote GA: mobile control of connected Mac/Windows hosts via authenticated one-to-one QR pairing (iOS/Android <-> host).
- New DigitalOcean plugin: provisions a Droplet, configures SSH, connects it as a remote Codex workspace.
- CLI 0.142.2: MCP tools use tool search by default; macOS auth honors system proxy/PAC/WPAD; remote stdio MCP servers accept absolute native paths; PowerShell unlowered-AST commands require approval.
